record.paper_title: Open Problems in Communication and Computation
record.original_question: Can algorithmic complexity and computational complexity be unified within a single theory?

evidence.quote: What about a unification of algorithmic complexity and computational complexity?

artifact.status_search_result: Unifying algorithmic (Kolmogorov) complexity with computational complexity remains a longstanding open program. Work on resource-bounded Kolmogorov complexity (Sipser, Levin, Allender, and others), the MCSP/MKtP problems, and meta-complexity has made significant partial progress connecting the two viewpoints, but no comprehensive unified theory satisfying the stated criteria is known.

status_evidence.title: Meta-complexity and Kolmogorov complexity (survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Research linking time-bounded Kolmogorov complexity (Kt, KT) with computational complexity classes such as NP, BPP, and the minimum circuit size problem.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues to relate algorithmic and computational complexity, indicating no completed unification.
